newsitem.title: USA: Ultramar sees larger Total acquisition gains.
newsitem.headline: Ultramar sees larger Total acquisition gains.

text.p: Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp on Tuesday reiterated that savings from its acquisition of Total Petroleum (North America) would exceed its original forecast.

At Ultramar's shareholder meeting, Chief Executive Roger Hemminghaus said the company would realize merger benefits of about $35 million in 1997, up from the original $25 million that had been projected for the year, Ultramar said in a statement.
Cost savings are expected to exceed $75 million in 1998, Hemminghaus said.

Cost savings and synergies from the acquisition of Total Petroleum are expected to be at least $50 million per year and Ultramar will also benefit from reduced operating inventories, a strengthened competitive position, and increased growth opportunities, he said.
